source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Room for 45 models, and only ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY models may embark. Each JUMP PACK, GRAVIS or TERMINATOR model counts as 2 models toward that limit, and each CENTURION model as 3. On top of that, it can carry 2 DREADNOUGHT models; a DREADNOUGHT model counts as many models as its Wounds (W) characteristic. The rule lists the 2 DREADNOUGHT models as an addition to the 45 yet also gives them a space cost, so it does not settle whether they count against the 45.

openQuestions: The 2 DREADNOUGHT models are listed in addition to the 45 ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY models, yet each is also given a space cost equal to its W characteristic; the text does not settle whether DREADNOUGHT models count against the 45.
